subject.title: fix(ai): provider-billed totals desync the cost breakdown and drop cache writes

question: Should OpenClaw’s public `Usage.cost` and worker transcript contract expose both a provider-billed authoritative `total` and a separate optional catalog `estimatedTotal` for plugin and replay consumers?
rationale: The code repair is mechanically coherent, but the added field changes a generated plugin SDK and closed worker protocol. Maintainers must choose the durable semantics rather than treating this as an internal implementation detail.

options.title: Approve the two-total contract
options.body: Document that `total` remains the authoritative provider-billed amount and `estimatedTotal` is the catalog component sum retained only when billing replaces it.

options.title: Land only token-accounting fixes
options.body: Remove the new public field and protocol propagation, then defer retained-estimate exposure to a separately designed SDK and worker-protocol proposal.

recommendation.title: Approve the two-total contract
recommendation.body: Document that `total` remains the authoritative provider-billed amount and `estimatedTotal` is the catalog component sum retained only when billing replaces it.

likelyOwner.reason: The transport feature history ties this accounting path to Vincent Koc, making him the best available routing candidate for the semantic contract decision.
